findings.summary: Inside `impl completions` (line 158), the local `import from jaclang.cli.command { ArgKind }` at line 161 binds a name the function body never references. Evidence: I read the whole function (lines 158-168) — its body uses only `shellcode`, `get_registry`, `_extract_commands`, `_install_completion`, and `console`; `ArgKind` appears nowhere between line 162 and the closing brace. The only code in this file that actually needs `ArgKind` is `_extract_commands` (lines 170-207), which performs its own local `import from jaclang.cli.command { ArgKind }` at line 171 before using it at lines 179, 182, and 190-191. Because Jac function-local imports do not leak into callees, deleting line 161 cannot break `_extract_commands`. One-line deletion, no signature change, no other file touched.
